requirements.statement: Accepted repository-framework normative authority SHALL reside within repo/.
Each accepted normative requirement SHALL have one stable machine-resolvable identity.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: The repository framework SHALL define Governance, Conformance, and Assurance as exactly three authority-bearing keystones.
Each keystone SHALL exercise only authority delegated by accepted repository-framework authority.

Implementation behavior, validation behavior, review findings, generated artifacts, workflow convention, historical repository state, and product behavior SHALL NOT independently create repository-framework normative authority.

conformance.rationale: Whether observed behavior semantically creates authority cannot be decided mechanically in Genesis.

requirements.statement: Persistent changes to accepted normative authority SHALL occur only through Governance.
Framework authority and product authority SHALL remain distinct.
Each planning-ready Design Proposal SHALL be maintained Markdown with one stable DP-NNN document identity.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Each addressable Design statement SHALL have one stable Design statement identity.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Design statement identities SHALL remain non-normative addresses.

conformance.rationale: The semantic non-authority of a Design address is established by framework authority and reviewed by Assurance.

requirements.statement: Planning SHALL bind every consumed Design Proposal to one exact and retrievable Design Proposal revision.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Each functional set SHALL select its bounded Design scope using Design statement identities.
The repository framework SHALL contain exactly one functional set identified as FS0-GENESIS with kind genesis.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: FS0-GENESIS SHALL have no accepted framework predecessor.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Each successor framework functional set SHALL identify one exact accepted repository predecessor.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Each functional-set directory SHALL contain functional-set.json and plan.json.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Planning SHALL own repository normative distillation and implementation intent.

conformance.rationale: Ownership of normative distillation and implementation intent is a semantic responsibility boundary.

requirements.statement: Each Plan SHALL declare the normative changes proposed by that Plan without making the Plan the persistent owner of accepted normative authority.
Each Plan SHALL identify every repository mutation path authorized for its Build.
Each Plan SHALL define implementation sequencing.
Each Plan SHALL define implementation invariants.
Each Plan SHALL define validation intent.
Each Plan SHALL define Assurance intent.
Each Plan SHALL define completion conditions.
An accepted Plan SHALL authorize Build only within the implementation scope declared by that Plan.
Build SHALL consume exactly one accepted Plan.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Build SHALL NOT mutate repository paths outside the accepted Plan's authorized mutation set.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Build SHALL produce a machine-readable manifest of realized repository mutations.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Build verification SHALL establish syntactic validity.
Build verification SHALL establish mechanical Conformance.
Build verification SHALL establish operational completion for the functional set.
Build verification SHALL establish fidelity to the accepted Plan.
Build acceptance SHALL require all applicable Conformance and Assurance obligations for the candidate realization to be satisfied.
Each active normative requirement SHALL have exactly one canonical Conformance applicability determination.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Each active normative requirement with mechanical Conformance applicability SHALL resolve to at least one executable assertion.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: An active normative requirement with Conformance applicability none SHALL resolve to no Conformance assertion and SHALL record a rationale when the absence of mechanical responsibility is not self-evident.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Each Conformance assertion SHALL identify exactly one accepted normative requirement as its direct semantic owner.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Conformance assertion identity SHALL remain distinct from implementation identity.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Multiple Conformance assertions MAY share one implementation while retaining distinct assertion identities, requirement ownership, and findings.

conformance.rationale: This is a permissive architectural capability; absence of sharing is not nonconformance.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Each gating Conformance assertion SHALL be reachable from canonical Conformance execution.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Canonical Conformance execution SHALL detect missing mechanical requirement coverage.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Canonical Conformance execution SHALL detect invalid assertion ownership.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Canonical Conformance execution SHALL detect unreachable gating assertions.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Canonical Conformance execution SHALL detect missing assertion results.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Canonical Conformance execution SHALL detect assertion failure.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: repo/scripts/validate SHALL be the canonical public repository Conformance execution entry point.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Each active normative requirement SHALL have exactly one canonical Assurance applicability determination.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: Each active normative requirement with required Assurance applicability SHALL resolve to at least one governed review obligation.

assurance.rationale: Genesis assigns no independent semantic-review obligation beyond mechanical enforcement for this requirement.

requirements.statement: An Assurance finding SHALL remain bounded to its review case and SHALL NOT independently create or amend persistent normative authority.
Planning acceptance SHALL require all applicable Planning Conformance and Assurance obligations to be satisfied.
Build acceptance SHALL advance exactly one explicit accepted repository state.

The repository root SHALL contain README.md that identifies the repository as the portable repo-spec framework seed, explains FS0-GENESIS at a high level, identifies the canonical validation entry point, and states that normal framework development continues through successor functional sets.

The repository root SHALL contain AGENTS.md that directs human and AI contributors to respect accepted repository authority, preserve Design/Planning/Build responsibility boundaries, avoid inventing missing semantics or authority, and use canonical Conformance before claiming completion.
The repository root SHALL contain LICENSE with the complete GNU General Public License version 3 text as the durable repository licensing artifact required for portable reuse of the Genesis seed.
FS0-GENESIS SHALL preserve an exact immutable snapshot of every Design Proposal revision it consumes within its portable planning artifacts.

assurance.rationale: Snapshot presence is mechanically verifiable; semantic portability boundaries are covered separately.

requirements.statement: Each preserved Genesis Design Proposal snapshot SHALL be identified by a SHA-256 digest of its exact bytes.
Genesis validation SHALL resolve selected Design statement identities against the digest-verified preserved Design Proposal snapshot.
The Genesis Design snapshot mechanism SHALL NOT require ordinary successor functional sets or Plans to duplicate Design Proposal content.

conformance.rationale: Whether Genesis bootstrap representation has been incorrectly generalized into successor Planning semantics is a semantic architecture boundary reviewed by Assurance.

requirements.statement: A preserved Genesis Design Proposal snapshot SHALL NOT replace the maintained Design Proposal as the canonical Design semantic source.

conformance.rationale: Whether a historical Genesis snapshot has displaced the maintained Design Proposal as the canonical semantic source is a semantic authority boundary rather than a stable purely mechanical predicate.

requirements.statement: Each executable Conformance assertion SHALL satisfy the governed evidence obligations applicable to that assertion.

assurance.rationale: Evidence-closure existence and correspondence are mechanically decidable; semantic evidence sufficiency remains an Assurance responsibility where separately required.

requirements.statement: The initial commit of the derived FS0-GENESIS repository SHALL establish the root repository revision for post-Genesis provenance.
Post-Genesis repository provenance SHALL NOT depend on repository ancestry preceding the initial derived FS0-GENESIS repository commit.

An Assurance finding used for Planning or Build acceptance SHALL remain historically resolvable to its review case, authorizing authority, reviewed candidate revision, exercised obligations, and evidence basis.

conformance.rationale: Historical semantic-review resolution is enforced through governed Assurance and Governance lifecycle evidence rather than continuously re-evaluated as a repository-local mechanical predicate.

requirements.statement: Every maintained Conformance primitive SHALL resolve through direct or transitive governed provenance to at least one accepted normative requirement.

assurance.rationale: Conformance primitive provenance is a mechanically decidable closure property; semantic authority remains owned by the accepted normative requirements.
